en: Grrr! Your brother took your toy, and you feel so angry! What do you do?
A man once asked <SAW>: Please give me some advice!
And the answer was: Do not get angry! The man asked again and again, and every time, the answer was: Do not get angry!
So when you feel angry, stop... and take a deep breath.
After that, use kind words: Can I have my toy back, please?
Staying calm is what a strong Muslim does!
Now, can you stay calm today? Say: Yes, I can!
voice_fix_note: lines 4 and 6 re-voiced (variants 0 and 3 of jobs/2026-11-11_kids_fix.json): whisper heard 'Then use' as 'The news' and 'Can you' as 'Please'
